paper_metadata.title: Effects of alloying elements on cohesion and fracture toughness of Zr grain boundary

evidence.quote: Density functional theory is performed to comparatively examine how alloying elements (Sn, Fe, Cr, Cu, and Nb) modulate the grain boundary stability, cohesive strength, Young's modulus, and fracture toughness for HCP Zr { 10 11 } grain boundary.
